'''''Calamagrostis stricta''''', known as '''slim-stem small reed grass'''<ref name=WDNR/> or '''narrow small-reed''',<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |accessdate=2014-10-17 }}</ref>  is a species of [[Tussock (grass)|bunchgrass]] in the family [[Poaceae]] of the [[Boreal Kingdom|Holarctic Kingdom]].

==Description==

===General description===
The species is perennial and caespitose with elongated [[rhizome]]s and {{convert|30|–|100|cm}} long [[culm (botany)|culms]] which are also erect. The leaf-sheaths are keelless and have a [[glabrousness|glabrous]] surface. It leaf-blades are {{convert|30|–|60|cm}} by {{convert|1.5|–|5|mm}} and are flat and stiff. The leaf-blade also have a ribbed and pubescent surface with scaberulous margins the apex of which is filiformed. The [[panicle]] is [[inflorescence]]d and lanceolate with the diameter being {{convert|7|–|20|cm}} by {{convert|1|–|3|cm}}. The main branches of the panicle are appressed and are {{convert|3|–|6|cm}} long while the other branches are terete and scabrous.<ref name=kew>{{cite web|url= https://www.kew.org/data/grasses-db/www/imp01970.htm|author=W.D. Clayton |author2=M. Vorontsova |author2-link=Maria Vorontsova (botanist)|author3=K.T. Harman |author4=H. Williamson|title=Calamagrostis stricta |publisher=The Board of Trustees and [[Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew|Royal Botanic Gardens]]|place=[[Kew]]|date=November 16, 2012|accessdate=November 2, 2013}}</ref>

===Spikelets and lemma===
Its [[spikelet]]s are solitary, lanceolate, and are {{convert|3|–|4|mm}} long. They have [[pedicel (botany)|pedicelled]] fertile spikelets which are {{convert|0.5|–|2|mm}} long, filiformed, and have the same features as the branches. The spikelets also carry fertile one which have a {{convert|0.2|mm}} long [[Rachilla (floral axis)|rhachilla]] which is pilosed. It [[callus]] is hairy with its hairs being {{convert|0.6|–|0.75|mm}} long, barely reaching the [[lemma (botany)|lemma]]. Its lemma have a toothed apex which is also truncate and [[awn (botany)|awned]]. The fertile lemma is {{convert|2.5|–|3.5|mm}} long and is both membranous and oblong. The species also have an elliptic and hyaline [[palea (botany)|palea]] which is {{convert|0.6|–|0.7|mm}} long of lemma.<ref name=kew/>

===Glumes, flowers and fruits===
The [[glume]]s are firmer than fertile lemma and are elliptic, membranous, with acute apexes and asperulous surfaces. The [[flower]]s have two lodicules and two [[stigma (botany)|stigmas]]. They also have three [[stamen]]s which are {{convert|2|–|2.5|mm}} long with it [[fruit]]s being [[caryopsis]] and [[wikt:fusiform|fusiform]]ed with an additional [[pericarp]]. The fruits also have a [[farinose]]d [[endosperm]] and punctiform [[hilum (biology)|hilum]].<ref name=kew/>

==Distribution==
''Calamagrostis stricta'' is found in [[wetlands]] throughout [[Eurasia]] (including [[Siberia]]) and into [[Mongolia]] and [[China]]. It is also common in [[Canada]] and the [[United States]] to which it was possibly introduced.<ref name=kew/>
